item.text:
**3B.10 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**

Overall: **mixed, leaning negative**. AMLO’s government did make some restrained moves in specific crises, but the year still ended with **high extortion, persistent disappearances, ongoing violence against journalists and searchers, major forced-displacement growth, and unresolved militarized abuse**. I do not see evidence that citizens were broadly safer from political violence and preventable domestic insecurity than when he inherited office.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Presidente alista carpeta de información para familiares de 43 normalistas de Ayotzinapa | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-04 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-alista-carpeta-de-informacion-para-familiares-de-43-normalistas-de-ayotzinapa/ | The government said it was still gathering information, had produced general progress, and would deliver a dossier to families of the disappeared students. This shows continued crisis management through investigation and family engagement rather than simple closure or denial. | 3B.10, 2B.9, 3B.4 |
| Positive | Mexican government offers public apology to families of missing girls and women and femicide victims in Ciudad Juarez | SRE | 2024-03-06 | https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/mexican-government-offers-public-apology-to-families-of-missing-girls-and-women-and-femicide-victims-in-ciudad-juarez?idiom=en | The state publicly acknowledged responsibility and apologized for failures in a long-running gender-violence case. That is a real accountability signal, though it is limited and retrospective. | 3B.10, 3B.7, 2B.9 |
| Positive, limited | AMLO acepta represión violenta en Veracruz; informa que hay dos detenidos | El Economista | 2024-07-16 | https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html | AMLO said police used violence against protesters in Veracruz, said they should not have acted that way, and said two officers were detained. This is one of the clearest restraint responses to a domestic flare-up. | 3B.10, 3B.9, 3B.8 |
| Positive, limited | Biden and AMLO agreed to coordinate immediate measures to reduce irregular border crossings while protecting human rights | Reuters | 2024-04-30 | https://theprint.in/world/us-mexico-to-clamp-down-on-illegal-immigration-leaders-say/2062785/ | Border pressure was handled through coordination and human-rights language rather than blanket punishment. This is not a full domestic-safety victory, but it is a controlled response to a real security problem. | 3B.10, 3B.9, 3B.6 |
| Negative | Mexico | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/rampant-extortion-reveals-corrosive-hole-in-mexico-security-strategy-3283251 | Reuters said extortion remained far above the level when AMLO took office, which undercuts any claim that everyday insecurity was broadly reduced. | 3B.10 |
| Negative | World Report 2024: Mexico | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico | HRW says AMLO made little progress on extreme criminal violence, abuses against migrants, gender-based violence, attacks on journalists and defenders, torture, disappearances, and extrajudicial killings. This is broad evidence that citizens were not substantially safer. | 3B.10, 3B.1, 3B.2, 3B.4, 3B.7 |
| Negative | Mexico | Amnesty International | 2025-04-29 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/americas/north-america/mexico/report-mexico/ | Amnesty says 2024 still saw killings and disappearances of women and girls, killings of searchers, and serious failures in protection. The report also says forced displacement remained severe in several states. | 3B.10, 3B.7, 3B.1, 3B.4 |
| Negative | Human rights in Mexico | Amnesty International | 2025-04-29 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/americas/north-america/mexico/report-mexico/ | Amnesty says relatives of disappeared people had to do their own searches, and six searchers were killed in 2024; it also reports that internal forced displacement rose sharply to at least 28,900 in 2024. That is strong negative evidence on safety and displacement. | 3B.10, 3B.7, 3B.1 |
| Negative | Mexico: Killings of journalists under state protection show urgent need to strengthen federal mechanism | Amnesty International / CPJ | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/mexico-killings-journalists-strengthen-federal-mechanism/ | Journalists under the federal protection mechanism were still being killed, showing that state protection for a vulnerable group was failing in practice. | 3B.10, 3B.7, 3B.4, 3B.9 |
| Negative | Mexico | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights | HRW warned the proposed changes could weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy and transparency safeguards. That is negative evidence on domestic safety because it widens coercive capacity rather than reducing it. | 3B.10, 3B.5, 3B.8, 3B.9 |
| Negative | Mexico’s military’s role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny | Reuters | 2024-10-16 | https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/ | Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants and local residents disputed the military account. This is direct evidence that security-force mobilization still produced lethal harm to civilians. | 3B.10, 3B.1, 2B.9, 3B.2 |

**Assessment**

- Best positive evidence: **Ayotzinapa case handling**, **Ciudad Juárez apology**, and the **Veracruz police restraint case**.
- Best negative evidence: **extortion stayed very high**, **disappearances and femicide remained severe**, **journalist protection failed**, and **forced displacement rose sharply**.
- My read is **not safer overall than inherited**. There were some narrower accountability and restraint signals, but they did not offset the broader insecurity picture.

**Search gap**

- I found **strong evidence on criminal insecurity, disappearances, gender violence, and displacement**, but less direct 2024 evidence on a single national metric showing net improvement or decline in all violence categories.
- The strongest positive items are mostly **case-specific** or **retrospective accountability gestures**, not proof of a broad safety improvement.
